description: Discord server onboarding and setup. Actions: get, set_welcome, set_rules, set_verification, set_onboarding.

action.description: Action: get (current config), set_welcome (welcome screen), set_rules (rules channel), set_verification (level), set_onboarding (prompts & defaults).

default_channels.description: Default channel IDs for new members (set_onboarding).

guild_id.description: Guild ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID env var.

prompts.description: Onboarding prompts array (set_onboarding). Each: {title, options: [{title, description?, emoji_name?, channel_ids?, role_ids?}], single_select?, required?, in_onboarding?}

rules_channel.description: Channel name or ID for rules (set_rules).

system_channel.description: Channel name or ID for system messages (set_rules).

verification_level.description: Verification level (set_verification). none=unrestricted, low=email, medium=5min, high=10min, very_high=phone.

name: discord_onboarding
